concept: IAM cross-account: AssumeRole or presigned URL for temporary partner access
tests: Temporary access for a partner from another account to upload to S3 without standing credentials.
expected: (1) A cross-account IAM role the partner assumes via sts:AssumeRole; (2) short-lived pre-signed URLs for upload. Triggers: "another AWS account", "temporary", "without standing IAM credentials".
why_not: An IAM user with an access key is a long-lived secret; public write on the bucket is insecure.
